name: learning-tool
description: Learn anything from your own agent: it researches the topic and builds a short interactive lesson of animated clips, predictions and sliders you can drag, with a source behind every claim. One offline page.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key (optional)
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Leave empty for text-only lessons. If you set a key, the narration text of each lesson you publish is sent to ElevenLabs (elevenlabs.io) to add spoken audio, which uses your ElevenLabs credits.
